title: Proximity-verification policy
description: Committed policy declaration for proximity verification on this assembly. Captures the required detection band only — the per-handoff nonce + signed witness payload travel in the sister schema figaro-proximity-proof-v1 at runtime. Sister-schema split mirrors GHG-disclosure (committed) + GHG-measurement (runtime).

fields.name: band
fields.description: Required detection modality. none = no proximity verification required. zone-wifi = same WiFi network. nearby-ble = BLE proximity. contact-nfc = physical NFC tap.
